quote: The operator of a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter shall not: Intentionally interfere with the movement of a motor vehicle.

activation.source_clause: operator of a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter
activation.description: Rider is operating a qualifying bicycle and a separate motor vehicle moves.

obligation.source_clause: Intentionally interfere with the movement of a motor vehicle
obligation.description: Keep intentional interference as an independent judgment; retain movement response.

timing.source_clause: Intentionally interfere with the movement of a motor vehicle
timing.description: No numeric statutory timing or mandatory reaction-order cutoff is supplied.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: operator of a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original vehicle class, wheel configuration, propulsion and rider relation require review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Intentionally interfere with the movement of a motor vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: Intent and legal interference cannot be inferred from a kinematic reaction alone.
